role.huarolemods.vengeance_agent.descrip:
Killer Team
The Vengeance Agent must purchase contracts to mark two random innocent players as targets. Targets glow purple in normal vision, and killing them grants double rewards.
The Vengeance Agent's ability is the Lens, which lets you select and inspect a target's inventory. The Lens must be purchased from the shop before use!
The Vengeance Knife is the Vengeance Agent's exclusive blade; its cooldown decreases as player count increases (minimum 10s).
